title: Saturday morning cake pickup for Stanhope Gardens and Riverstone parties
summary:
A 10am party in Stanhope Gardens means the cake needs to be in hand by 9:30. Most bakeries nearby don't open until 9 on a Saturday. Riverstone opens at 7.

100% eggless. Not some cakes, every cake. Six sizes, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher, any design you send us. Free parking at the shopping centre, which is why a Saturday pickup takes minutes, not a lap around the block.

48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes. Order by Thursday for a Saturday party.

WhatsApp +61 425 697 725 to book.
